page_title: NAN 1-4 NIC | Nantes v Nice 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' 1 - 4 Goal! Tanguy Ndombele passes the ball to Tom Louchet (Nice) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Anthony Lopes couldn't do anything about it. 1:4.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) for Morgan Sanson.
89' Claude Puel has decided to substitute Mohamed-Ali Cho and he is replaced by Gabin Bernardeau (Nice).
87' Substitution. Matthis Abline is replaced by Youssef El Arabi (Nantes).
86' Morgan Sanson (Nice) is booked by the referee.
85' Jonathan Clauss slides a brilliant pass into Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
84' Matthis Abline (Nantes) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
82' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Maxime Dupe was alert and made a comfortable save.
81' Ahmed Kantari decides to make a substitution. Ibrahima Sissoko will be replaced by Bahmed Deuff (Nantes).
81' Charles Vanhoutte will be replaced by Dante (Nice).
77' The resulting corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
76' Tiago Gouveia (Nice) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. Nice earn a corner.
76' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
73' Total attempts – 11:5.
71' What a miskick by Ibrahima Sissoko (Nantes). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
70' Claude Puel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tom Louchet (Nice) replacing Elye Wahi.
70' Substitution. Tiago Gouveia (Nice) in, Sofiane Diop out.

68' A huge opportunity wasted! Kelvin Amian (Nantes) produces a header from a rebound inside the six-yard box. His effort is denied by one of the defenders who is well positioned and clears the ball to safety.
68' The resulting corner from Remy Cabella (Nantes) comes to nothing.
66' CHANCE! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) rises high to meet the resultant corner kick and attempts to steer his fine header past the goalkeeper, but only hits the right post!
65' The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) tries to find Sofiane Diop, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
62' Chance! Matthis Abline (Nantes) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
60' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

60' Elye Wahi (Nice) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
58' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
56' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is penalised for holding. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem signals a set piece.
55' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Matthis Abline (Nantes).
55' Nantes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
53' PENALTY APPEAL after Matthis Abline (Nantes) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
52' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
50' Elye Wahi (Nice) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort well wide of the left post.
48' Elye Wahi (Nice) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
47' A great run from Elye Wahi (Nice) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
46' The whistle blows and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem starts the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' Chidozie Awaziem (Nantes) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity!
45+2' 1 - 3 GOAL! The corner comes over and Chidozie Awaziem wins a simple header before Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) nods the ball into the back of the net. 1:3.
45+1' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nantes.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Remy Cabella (Nantes) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the left side of the goal. Maxime Dupe is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.
43' A player from Nice commits a rough challenge. Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
40' 0 - 3 Goal! Sofiane Diop (Nice) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:3.
38' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matthis Abline (Nantes) was quite harsh and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Remy Cabella (Nantes) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
37' Matthis Abline (Nantes) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
34' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
31' Remy Cabella (Nantes) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
29' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Morgan Sanson plays it into the box, and Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
28' Elye Wahi (Nice) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
26' Nantes seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Elye Wahi (Nice) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
23' 56:44 – the latest ball possession ratio.
21' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul.
19' The ball is cleared after Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
17' Ali Abdi (Nice) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.

16' 0 - 1 Jonathan Clauss passes to Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 0:1.
14' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is caught offside!
12' Remy Cabella (Nantes) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
10' Kojo Peprah (Nice) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
8' Johann Lepenant (Nantes) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
8' Kojo Peprah (Nice) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
7' Elye Wahi (Nice) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
5' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Elye Wahi (Nice) heads on.
4' Nice are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

3' Remy Cabella (Nantes) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
